Answer: B
Reason: Comparing the pre-operative image (Figure 1a), which shows a massive right-sided opacity causing leftward mediastinal shift, with the post-operative image (Figure 1c), there is clear evidence of surgical clips and re-expansion of the right lung; however, the heart and trachea remain shifted to the left, indicating only partial resolution of the mass effect or persistent volume loss/shift.
